description: ESIM Agent: SessionStart adds a one-line pointer to the delegate tool and, for a new minor or major version, an update notice; the edit guard (edits and Bash file writes) is off until /esim-agent:hook on; after a esim-agent FAIL or PARTIAL, Claude hands the step to a Sonnet subagent (or, with takeover: self, its own calls are capped at limits.takeover_calls), and after an OK it does not re-run tests. Shell tests keep both free (no npx) while unused.

hooks.command: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && { [ -f "$r/.esim-agent/hook.json" ] || [ -f "$r/.esim-agent/hook/takeover" ]; } && npx -y esim-agent@1.3.2 hook guard; exit 0
